items.t: Rivian CEO says robotaxis won't end car ownership — he's betting on both
items.sum: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe doesn't think robotaxis will kill car ownership in America, and he's building the company's self-driving strategy around that belief.

items.t: Could Rivian Actually Get Back to $22? Stifel Thinks So, Even as 2027 Loss Estimates Widen
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRivian stock is 40% below its December high, and Stifel reiterated its Buy rating and $22 price target this week. Stifel is betting on R2, which became Rivian’s best-selling vehicle in the third quarter as revenue rose 38%.
Rivian's Q3 revenue rose 38% & guidance improved; cash burn hit $1.12B, liquidity exceeded $7B, and short interest hit a record near 12%. More on RIVN stock.
